standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.
Only the greatest heroes of this land may gain entrance to this guild.

options.text: I'm a hero, may I apply to join?

steps.player: I'm a hero - may I apply to join?

steps.npc: You're a hero? I've never heard of YOU. You are required to possess at least 55 quest points to file an application.
Additionally you must have completed the Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal and Dragon Slayer I quests.

options.text: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.

steps.player: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.
